Application Data.NAME: Design Innovations LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Design Innovations LLC specializes in providing high-quality interior decorating and design services for residential spaces. Our operations include careful planning and execution of color consultations, furniture selection, and the sourcing of soft furnishings. We focus on delivering a personalized design experience for our clients while ensuring all activities remain within the scope of non-structural alterations. Our firm maintains comprehensive project documentation, which includes detailed contracts and client approvals, to effectively mitigate professional liability exposures. Additionally, we offer tile and mosaic installation services, ensuring clear separation between design and installation efforts. To protect client data, we employ secure digital storage solutions and robust cybersecurity measures. Our commitment to quality and compliance ensures that all materials sourced meet legal and environmental regulations.
